settings.q: Is this a custom-built model or ready-made?
settings.a: Each Black Pearl barge vessel is custom-built and hand-finished to order. Standard lead time is 14–21 business days from order confirmation.

settings.q: Can you build a model of our own vessel or barge?
settings.a: Yes. Send us drawings, GA plans or photos and we'll build an accurate scale replica of your exact vessel, complete with your branding and livery.

settings.q: Does it come with a display case and base?
settings.a: Yes — the model is delivered on a finished wooden base with a clear protective cover to keep it pristine on a desk, reception or showroom.
Yes, we ship worldwide from Dubai, UAE, packed in custom protective crating with full tracking and insured delivery.

settings.case_quote: Barge is an impressive display which is kept in our office. Whenever we have meetings, we show them these ship models and it makes explaining our operations easier.
settings.prov_p: Barge is a flat bottomed marine vessel which is mainly used to transport heavy cargos through inland waterway. They are capable to take huge payload which makes them a cost effective method of transportation.
